subject: WL
title: Spanish II
description: Spanish II moves students from Novice High toward Intermediate Low proficiency. Students review the present tense and reflexive verbs, then narrate in the preterite and imperfect, give commands, talk about travel with the future, discuss health with the present perfect, and make recommendations with the present subjunctive. Cultural study includes Día de los Muertos, regional cuisines, Latin American geography, environmental issues, and the art and music of the Spanish-speaking world, assessed through integrated performance assessments.
framework: 2019 California World Languages Standards; 2020 CA World Languages Framework (Novice High to Intermediate Low)

standards.WL-COMM1-NH: Interpretive communication (Novice High): understand and infer meaning from simple authentic oral, written, and signed texts on familiar topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-NH: Interpersonal communication (Novice High): exchange information in conversations on familiar topics using phrases and simple sentences, asking and answering questions.
standards.WL-COMM3-NH: Presentational communication (Novice High): present information on familiar topics using simple sentences in speaking and writing.
standards.WL-COMM1-IL: Interpretive communication (Intermediate Low): understand the main idea and some details in simple authentic texts on familiar and some new topics.
standards.WL-COMM2-IL: Interpersonal communication (Intermediate Low): create with language to handle short social interactions and everyday transactions, asking and answering a variety of questions.
standards.WL-COMM3-IL: Presentational communication (Intermediate Low): present information on familiar topics using connected sentences in speaking and writing.
standards.WL-CULT1-NH: Cultures (Novice High): identify and describe products and practices of Spanish-speaking cultures and relate them to perspectives.
standards.WL-CULT1-IL: Cultures (Intermediate Low): compare products, practices, and perspectives of Spanish-speaking cultures with one's own.
standards.WL-CULT2-IL: Intercultural interaction (Intermediate Low): use culturally appropriate behavior and language in familiar situations.
standards.WL-STRUC1-NH: Structures (Novice High): use language structures (present tense, reflexives, past tenses) to communicate in the modes at the Novice High level.
standards.WL-STRUC1-IL: Structures (Intermediate Low): use language structures (preterite/imperfect, commands, future, present perfect, subjunctive expressions) to communicate at the Intermediate Low level.
standards.WL-CONN1-IL: Connections (Intermediate Low): use Spanish to build and reinforce knowledge in other disciplines (geography, science, art, health).

units.title: ¡Bienvenidos de nuevo! Daily Routines and Review
units.big_idea: Describing who we are and what we do every day reactivates the present tense and adds reflexive verbs.

units.title: Mi niñez: Childhood Memories
units.big_idea: The imperfect tense lets us describe how things used to be.

units.title: Celebraciones: Telling What Happened
units.big_idea: The preterite narrates completed events, like the celebrations that mark the year in Spanish-speaking cultures.

units.title: ¡A comer! Food, Cooking, and Restaurants
units.big_idea: Food connects culture and community; we combine past tenses and give instructions with commands and pronouns.

units.title: De viaje: Travel and Geography
units.big_idea: Travel requires planning in the future, asking for directions, and understanding the Spanish-speaking world's geography.

units.title: La salud y el cuerpo: Health and Wellness
units.big_idea: Talking about health requires body vocabulary, formal commands, and what we have done.

units.title: Nuestra comunidad y el medio ambiente
units.big_idea: Communities solve problems together; we express recommendations and wishes with the subjunctive.

units.title: El arte y la música del mundo hispano
units.big_idea: Art and music express identity; comparing works builds description and opinion skills.

units.title: Proyecto final y repaso
units.big_idea: We show what we can do in Spanish across all three modes.

weeks.topic: ¿Quién soy yo? Reintroductions and present tense review

days.title: Presentaciones

days.title: Review & check
